title: Disruption limits around triaxial bodies and implications for ring-bearing minor bodies
summary: Symbolic regression supplied an empirical fit for modeled disruption limits around triaxial bodies; under stated assumptions it changes the modeled classification for Chariklo.

evidence.tested: Symbolic regression supplied an empirical fit for modeled disruption limits around triaxial bodies; under stated assumptions it changes the modeled classification for Chariklo.
evidence.unknown: The analysis does not establish ring origin, long-term stability or outcomes beyond the modeled fluid and density assumptions.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
